name: Skate style (skatewear)
description: Skateboarders' practical dress: T-shirts, flannel button-down shirts, hooded sweatshirts, webbing belts, khaki or denim shorts, pants or jeans and Dickies work pants, sold by skate-company clothing lines such as Vision Street Wear, Element and Zero.

name: Surf style (surfwear)
description: Beach and surfer dress that grew from local boardshort and wetsuit makers into labels such as O'Neill, Rip Curl, Quiksilver, Billabong, Volcom, Hurley and RVCA: boardshorts, baggies, rash guards, bikinis, graphic tees and hoodies.
